table_title: Unemployed persons, by age and sex

units.Unemployed (per cent): per cent of the labour force

transformations: None. The page changes only visual framing, selection of visible series, and display formatting. No seasonal adjustment, smoothing, interpolation, or modelling is applied.
method_note: The Labour Force Survey is sample-based. Statistics Norway states that quarterly estimates have higher standard errors than annual averages and advises caution when assessing changes between surveys.
series_break: A major LFS redesign took effect from 2021Q1. SSB estimates a break of about 5,400 unemployed persons; that break estimate was not statistically significant. SSB also reports the unemployment rate in the new LFS as 0.1 percentage points higher than under the old LFS.
verification_source: Statistics Norway Labour Force Survey release updated 25 August 2026, Table 4 and About the statistics.
